# Skill mana/life cost model

- **Status:** ⬜ Pending
- **Mechanic tags:** cost, sustain
- **Backlog:** `SKILLCOST-01` (see `docs/INGAME_VERIFICATION_BACKLOG.md`)

## Setup

Note each skill's in-game per-cast Mana/Life cost, your mods/rolls, cast/attack rate. Compare to the app's Net Mana/Life Recovery drain.

## Derived / confirmed formula

Assumed: `cost = (base + flat Skill Cost) × Π(support mana multipliers) × (1 + increased − reduced)`. Awakening Skull (Arcane) is the marquee case: 100% Mana→Life + inflated Skill Cost.

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Pending — folded into Net Recovery as a separate drain (never "Consumed"). Open: formula order, triggered-skill exemption (engine counts all enabled actives), Frozen Lotus zeroes BASE only, Bull's Rage life-conversion deferred, whether cost counts as "consumed recently".
